source.implements: Remove: the list leaves the phone (the kept export, the list, its per-battle ticks and its Clever Know-wotz boxes), the app goes to the home screen

Clever Know-wotz: every army and detachment rule, each option of one (unless a unit of the list has it as an ability: listed as theirs) and every ability of the list (the same one on several units one line), by data.js CHECKLIST (verify/derive.js): To do now in each phase and turn its text says it is triggered (07.02: the phases; either turn: both), or under the moment it opens with (Start of the (first) battle round, End of your opponent's turn); Active now where its effect is used and it is not triggered; once-per-battle ones (perBattle; Kindred Sorcery's options each) under Once per battle, from where they are triggered, with the Overview's boxes; each line names its unit or source and opens the full text; a rule another rule of the list gives to units by keyword (g) says which and to whom; inert rules and abilities the list cannot use are listed, marked; what the table cannot place under When unclear, what has no phase under No phase; no stratagems; a box per line per section, kept per list; Reset clears them (with Undo), not the once-per-battle ones

an option of a rule or ability on the Clever Know-wotz: its own trigger (and where it is used); with none, where its effect is used (chosen when its rule is triggered: a once-per-battle one is listed there); with neither, its rule's trigger; not derivable: When unclear

data.js CHECKLIST (verify/derive.js --write), the Clever Know-wotz table: per rule and ability, from its text without its options (withoutOptions): t the phases its text names (table 1's trigger) less those only the moment it opens with gives (Start of the battle round: not also the Command phase), at that moment, u where its effect is used (table 1's used-in); none: positively no phase (pre-battle); x: not derivable (nothing guessed); per option (optionsOf) its own trigger only when it names one, where it is used, x when it has neither and no trigger of its rule; g: an ability it gives units by keyword (grantsIn: to, the option, while); the same words on several units must give one entry, else x

judgement.code: const withoutOptions = (text, table) => { const t = rulesText(text); return optionsOf(t, table).reduce((s2, o) => s2.replace(o.text, ''), t); };

source.implements: a rule's or ability's own words for the Clever Know-wotz table: its text without its italic notes and without the text of each of its options (each option has its own entry)

judgement.code: const ckStored = (e, x) => e.x && (phasesOf(x).length || x.at) ? Object.assign({}, e, { x:0, at:x.at, t:phasesOf(x).map(p => p + ':' + phTurn(x, p)).join(',') }) : e;

source.implements: a rule or ability the derived table cannot place (x) but data.js has a phase tag for (ph, turn, at): listed where the tag says it triggers (the row's own timing), as To do now
